title: Ebola deaths in DR Congo pass 5,000 as reports cite spread to Nigeria
detail: Pulse Nigeria reports the DRC outbreak has killed more than 5,000 people and that cases have spread to Nigeria. Rio Times cites government data of 10,274 confirmed cases and 4,992 deaths as of 28 October; Wikipedia's 2 November table lists roughly 10,467 cases and 5,103 deaths. Figures differ by source and cut-off date, and the Nigeria detail has not been confirmed against an official health-authority statement.

media.caption: Ebola spreads to Nigeria after killing over 5,000 in DR Congo
